articles.summary: Fukuoka Jisho Co., Ltd., guided by its philosophy of “For an Exciting Fukuoka,” leads redevelopment and urban development projects including Canal City Hakata. The company’s DX Promotion Department, which manages IT infrastructure for seven group companies including subsidiaries, decided to move away from perimeter-based defense — which trusted connections based on location and destination — toward zero trust. It adopted Netskope as its cloud-first SSE (Security Service Edge) solution, using a single, consistent policy to gain visibility into and control over access to cloud services, the web, and internal systems. After restructuring its partner arrangement to establish stable operations, and carefully accounting for the needs of varied business lines such as its hotel operations, Fukuoka Jisho rolled out the platform across all seven group companies while minimizing disruption. Today, the company maintains the same level of security and convenience regardless of where employees work.
articles.title: Fukuoka Jisho Deploys Netskope Across Seven Group Companies to Deliver Secure Access Anywhere, Powered by SSE

articles.summary: Founded in 2001, BuySell Technologies Co., Ltd. has achieved an exceptional 67.8% year-over-year revenue growth rate in the reuse industry. As the company expanded its business, grew its workforce, and actively pursued mergers and acquisitions (M&A), the limitations of its existing perimeter-based security model became increasingly apparent. To address challenges including growing use of networks outside the corporate perimeter, the proliferation of shadow IT, inconsistent security policies across group companies, and the risk of data leakage in the cloud, BuySell Technologies deployed Netskope SASE/SSE and transitioned to a zero trust security model. The rollout began in 2025 and was completed across the entire group in August 2026, establishing a security foundation for continued growth. Looking ahead, the company also plans to expand visibility into shadow AI.
articles.title: BuySell Technologies Moves from Perimeter-Based Security to Zero Trust with Netskope SASE/SSE to Support Rapid Business Growth
